view_role: SECOND EVALUATION VIEW over the SEALED collection C (ADR-0009, S21). Same corpus bytes, same native links, NO new judging: only the query set (all 1072 judgeable) and the qrels restricted to it are new. The view lives INSIDE C's manifest entry, discriminated by an explicit `view` field on each file, NOT as a new collection id: the corpus is byte-identical, so collection_id stays 'C' and the embedding cache stays a legitimate HIT (ADR-0009 D3) instead of forcing a needless full re-encode of 47382 docs per arm for zero integrity gain.
method_detail: BEIR edition of CQADupStack native StackExchange 'duplicate of' moderator links (BeIR/cqadupstack-qrels unix/test.tsv) — THE SAME upstream links as the sealed C view, re-restricted to a larger query set. Query = a held-out question; relevant = its native duplicate question(s) present in the corpus (binary grade=1). qrels restricted to ALL 1072 judgeable queries -> 1693 rows (avg 1.58 rel/query). No closure/union-find needed (links are already question->duplicate-question pairs); self excluded. NO NEW JUDGING HAPPENS: judge=null, annotator unchanged.
annotator: upstream (StackExchange moderators 'duplicate of' links, via Hoogeveen et al. CQADupStack + BEIR repackaging)

source.license_verified_live: 2026-06-25 (both HF repos, at ingest — carried over from the sealed C view; NO new egress for this view)
source.citation: Hoogeveen, Verspoor & Baldwin 2015/2016 (ADCS), 'CQADupStack: A Benchmark Data Set for Community Question-Answering Research'; Sep-2014 StackExchange dump; BEIR repackaging Thakur et al. 2021
source.subforum_rationale: the most ITSM-adjacent IT/tech subforum (nearest to A's IT support tickets); adapter is slice-agnostic. Unchanged from the sealed C view — this view re-slices QUERIES, never the source.

query_selection.selection: --n-queries 0 = ALL judgeable queries (a query is judgeable iff it has >=1 native-relevant doc present in the corpus; all 1072 judgeable -> 100% coverage, 0 missing). No RNG draw is involved: the view is the FULL judgeable pool, deterministic and sorted by integer qid.
query_selection.qrels_shape: TREC `qid 0 docid 1` (same shape as B native and as the sealed C view)

primary_sample.definition: PRIMARY (ADR-0009 D2) = the 922 judgeable queries NEVER SCORED by either arm = 1072 judgeable − the 150 sealed-C qids. FROZEN as an explicit, sorted, committed, hard-hash-verified qid list so the sample is auditable and CANNOT drift: the run-lot MUST read this file, and MUST NOT re-derive the set difference on the fly.
primary_sample.derivation: bench/runners/build_corpus_C.py --view judgeable1072 --n-queries 0 --freeze-primary. The excluded 150 are read from the SEALED, hard-hash-verified qrels (corpus/qrels/C_cqadupstack_qrels.trec), and cross-checked against random.Random(13).sample(judgeable, 150) — the freeze REFUSES to write if the two disagree.
primary_sample.secondary_note: The full 1072 view is SECONDARY / DESCRIPTIVE ONLY and gates nothing (ADR-0009 D2): it CONTAINS the already-reported sealed 150. Re-reporting the sealed 150 alone as a result is FORBIDDEN (CONVENTION_HOLDOUT_POLICY §3); their only sanctioned role is the D4 positive control.

files.corpus: corpus/processed/C_cqadupstack_corpus.jsonl (47382 docs, regenerable:true, gitignored) — SHARED, byte-identical with the sealed C view (sha256=418e368b883751ee4088f78d68ad4371328e1211cd0fc4279df4a2c85cfaa0c0), NOT re-emitted by this view
files.qrels: corpus/qrels/C_cqadupstack_judgeable1072_qrels.trec (1693 rows, regenerable:false, committed, sha256=d26bd77b3b97502c152b3aad79413a6e5f6ff41b3130d7ff2eca15fac9f3c072, HARD hash-verified — AUD3-C2)

calibration: native duplicate-detection / known-item bench (StackExchange moderator 'duplicate of' links). comparability_class=native -> CROSS-COMPARABLE to B native (same family), NOT to A llm_judge. This view reports a WITHIN-C delta only (ADR-0005: no cross-method absolute comparison). Discriminance is a corpus property and is unchanged (median 613 chars / 101 words, normalized-collision 0.01%) — the corpus is the same bytes.

seal.lot: S21 S21_VIEW (ADR-0009 Accept, conditions AUD3-C2 + AUD3-C3)
seal.mechanism: The view's qrels + frozen primary qid list carry regenerable:false and are HARD hash-verified by verify_manifest_hashes(m,'C') (wired into Makefile eval-verify), exactly like the sealed C qrels — the new view has its own tamper anchor (AUD3-C2, both halves). The view's queries JSONL carries regenerable:true (heavy, gitignored) so the gate stays cold-clone-correct, matching existing C/A/B discipline.
seal.sealed_c_untouched: The EXISTING sealed C artefacts are NOT modified, moved or regenerated: corpus/queries/C_cqadupstack_queries.jsonl and corpus/qrels/C_cqadupstack_qrels.trec keep sha256 2337bea7c4e3cc054bca3fc27ddc8b4111bd7f3e4355513a799dd0461b7099c5 / e2b2289b3e3e2712bd2430484e97d337e124b3d9d6c3bb72385415469b3c39c5, verified after the build. bench/runs/baseline_lock.json is byte-untouched.
seal.view_selection: AUD3-C3: default C resolution is UNCHANGED — compare.resolve_triple(manifest,'C',None) and verify_manifest_hashes(m,'C',view=DEFAULT_VIEW) resolve to the ORIGINAL 150-query sealed view (the view-less files). This view is reachable ONLY by asking for it explicitly (view='judgeable1072').

no_measurement: This view was BUILT, not RUN. The lot that produced it encoded no query, ran no retrieval, computed no metric and opened no evaluation number. The single pre-registered comparison over the 922 (ADR-0009 D4) is a separate, later run-lot, evaluated and reported exactly ONCE.
